messages:
Juno (People Ops): Quick update: effective 2027-03-01 we're increasing the Adoption Assistance stipend from $2,000 to $5,000 and launching a simplified online claim form. Details below.

Marta (Benefits): The goal is to reduce reimbursement friction and better align with market benchmarks. New stipend covers adoption fees, legal costs, and reasonable travel.

Eli (Payroll): Operational note: payments route through payroll as a coded one-time benefit (code: ADOPT-2027). That ensures tax withholding where required; we'll provide country-specific notes.

Sam (Legal): Documentation: we'll accept the standard agency adoption invoice OR a signed attestation + proof of filing for domestic private adoptions to protect privacy. No extra medical records required.

Ava (Recruiting): Can we add this to candidate benefits callouts? It'll help for senior hires.

Juno (People Ops): Yes  recruiter one-pager updated. We'll also add a short FAQ and sample timeline for common cases (domestic agency, foster adoption, international).

Marta (Benefits): International adoptions: additional allowable travel reimbursement up to $2k included, but employees may need to coordinate visa/passport timing; we'll include checklists.

Eli (Payroll): Timeline: code added 2027-02-15, sample payroll run 2027-02-25, live for claims submitted on/after 2027-03-01. Retroactive requests for qualifying claims between 2026-10-01 and 2027-02-28 will be considered case-by-case.

Sam (Legal): Privacy reminder: adoption claims are confidential. Only People Ops and Payroll will see claim details; we'll anonymize data for benefits reporting.

Juno (People Ops): Action items: publish FAQ & form by 2027-02-10, update careers page, and host a 30-min drop-in on 2027-02-17 for questions.

Ava (Recruiting): Thanks! Can you send me the recruiter blurb when ready?

Marta (Benefits): Will do. HR-bot: policy link and form: https://intranet.redwood/workplace/policies/adoption-assistance-2027

Juno (People Ops): Thanks everyone  DM us with edge cases. :family:
